questions.stem: An engineer's design brief balances MnO4- -> Mn2+ in acid; if 4 H2O form, how many H+ are needed on the left?

options.text: 4 H+, because each water needs one H+.

questions.stem: An engineer's design brief uses P4O10; given oxygen is -2, what is phosphorus's oxidation number?

questions.stem: An engineer's design brief balances MnO4- + 8H+ + 5e- -> Mn2+ + 4H2O; what is the net charge on the left side?
